2. **Real-Time Auction, Marketplace & FinTech Escrow Systems:** Sub-second WebSocket/SignalR bidding, Redis Redlock distributed locks, PayOS/Stripe webhooks, and immutable double-entry ledger state machines.

## Flagship Production Systems
- **Biensovip.com (`https://biensovip.com` | `/projects/26`):** Real-time VIP License Plate, SIM & Collectibles Valuation + Live Bidding Marketplace. Built with Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, Redis Distributed Locks, Next.js, and Gemini AI valuation.
- **BrandHub (`https://brandhub.id.vn` | `/projects/14`):** B2B Influencer Marketing, Booking & Milestone Escrow Payment Platform. Built with ASP.NET Core 8 Clean Architecture, Next.js, SignalR, PostgreSQL, and PayOS Escrow State Machine. Documented with 84 Use Cases and 183 Atomic Functional Requirements (`FR-001` to `FR-183`).
- **The MC Hub (`https://mc-voice-training.vercel.app/` | `/projects/11`):** AI-Powered Public Speaking Coaching & Event MC Marketplace. Integrates Faster-Whisper ASR, Librosa acoustic prosody analysis, and Gemini 2.5 Flash coaching rubrics. **Top 20 Research Connect 2025 & Top 50 Open Innovation Day (OID) 2025**.
- **TikTok Live 3D Interactive Game Ecosystem (`/projects/30`):** 5 real-time interactive livestream games (*Duck Race 3D*, *Bomb Relay*, *Lucky Wheel*, *Territory War*, *Tug of War*) using Three.js, Cannon-es physics, and TikTok-Live-Connector WebSockets.
- **ThreadLearn AI (`/projects/24`):** Interactive Multi-Threaded Education SaaS with a custom 36-Key Gemini AI Rotation Pool, Circuit Breaker, and Token-Aware Smart Chunking.
- **JobFinder AI (`/projects/1`):** Intelligent Recruitment & AI CV-JD Matching Platform built with ASP.NET Core 8 Web API, SignalR, React 18, SQL Server, and 188 Atomic Functional Requirements (`FR-001` to `FR-188`).
